commander.name: Okoye, Mighty and Adored
commander.oracle:
When Okoye enters, you become the monarch.

oracle.Court of Grace:

oracle.Palace Jailer:

oracle.Anointed Procession: If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
oracle.Doubling Season:

oracle.Champion of Lambholt:

oracle.Okoye, Mighty and Adored:
When Okoye enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Whenever that creature attacks the monarch this turn, it gains double strike and trample until end of turn.

description: **Core** : Okoye becomes the monarch the moment she enters, so the whole plan is to claim the crown and keep it — every turn you hold it you draw an extra card and can pump a creature.

**Engine** : At the beginning of combat she puts a +1/+1 counter on target creature and gives it double strike and trample while it attacks the monarch — magnified by Doubling Season, Branching Evolution and Hardened Scales into a one-shot attacker.

**Payoff** : Court pieces (Court of Grace, Palace Jailer, Regal Behemoth, Throne of the High City) keep the crown and flood tokens, then a buffed double-striking attacker or Akroma's Will closes the game.
win: **Buffed double striker** : Okoye's combat counter — doubled by Doubling Season and Branching Evolution — turns a designated creature into a lethal double-striking, trampling attacker against the monarch.
**Angel swarm** : While you hold the crown, Court of Grace makes a 4/4 flying Angel each upkeep, and Anointed Procession or Doubling Season doubles them into a flying army.
**Akroma's Will** : With your commander on the field you choose both modes, giving the whole team double strike, flying, vigilance, lifelink and protection — one attack wipes the table.

Court of Grace.Monarch: **Crown engine** : It makes you the monarch on entry and, while you keep the crown, escalates its upkeep token from a 1/1 Spirit to a 4/4 flying Angel — doubling the plan's reward.

Palace Jailer.Monarch: **Monarch removal** : It claims the crown on entry and exiles an opponent's creature until someone else takes the monarchy — tempo removal that also secures your extra draw.

Throne of the High City.Monarch: **Crown land** : A land that sacrifices for four mana to make you the monarch, guaranteeing the draw and the double-strike trigger whenever you need to reclaim the throne.

Regal Behemoth.Monarch: **Monarch ramp** : It becomes the monarch on entry with trample, and while you hold the crown every land taps for an extra mana — fueling Okoye's pumps.

Anointed Procession.Monarch: **Token doubler** : It doubles every token you create, so Court of Grace's Angels and Adeline's Humans go twice as wide while you hold the crown.

Doubling Season.Monarch: **Double tokens and counters** : It doubles the +1/+1 counters Okoye puts on her attacker as well as your token production, supercharging the monarch plan's reward.

Cathars' Crusade.Monarch: **Board pump** : Every creature that enters puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, snowballing your token swarm into a huge army.

Champion of Lambholt.Monarch: **Unblockable outlet** : Creatures with less power than it can't block, and it grows whenever another creature enters — making your buffed double-striker unblockable.

Branching Evolution.Monarch: **Counter doubler** : The +1/+1 counter Okoye puts on target creature each combat is doubled, making the buffed attacker lethal in a single swing.

Hardened Scales.Monarch: **Counter plus one** : Every +1/+1 counter dropped on the designated attacker lands one extra, a cheap early repetition of Okoye's combat pump.

Unbreakable Formation.Monarch: **Protection and pump** : It makes your creatures indestructible, and in your main phase also drops a +1/+1 counter with vigilance, keeping the buffed attacker alive.

Akroma's Will.Monarch: **Finisher** : With Okoye as your commander it gives your whole team double strike, flying and vigilance — or lifelink, indestructible and protection — ending a turn that was already threatening.

Felidar Retreat.Monarch: **Landfall engine** : Every land you play makes either a 2/2 Cat token or a +1/+1 with vigilance, an engine that pairs with the extra draws of holding the crown.

Avenger of Zendikar.Monarch: **Plant army** : It creates a 0/1 Plant for each land you control and pumps them on every landfall, a classic finisher that doubles the monarch's board.

Adeline, Resplendent Cathar.Monarch: **Attack token army** : On every attack she makes a 1/1 Human attacking each opponent, flooding the board and giving Okoye more bodies to buff into double-striking threats.

Torens, Fist of the Angels.Monarch: **Creature-cast tokens** : Every creature spell you cast makes a 1/1 Human Soldier token with training, converting your monarch card draw into a wide army.

Bastion Protector.Monarch: **Crown guardian** : Your commander gains +2/+2 and indestructible, so Okoye survives combat and keeps delivering the monarch and pump triggers turn after turn.

Engines: Token doublers, counter multipliers and attack-token makers that turn the monarch's extra draw into a wide, pumping board.
Wincons: Unblockable outlets, finisher instants and Plant armies that convert Okoye's buffed double-striker into lethal combat damage.
Flex: Protection and utility pieces that guard the crown and keep the monarch engine running.
CardAdvantage: Monarch-granting cards that secure the extra draw every turn while the crown is yours.

quick_read: **Become king** : Okoye makes you the monarch the moment she enters, so you draw an extra card every turn while you keep the crown.
**Pump and slam** : At the beginning of combat she puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature that gains double strike and trample while attacking the monarch — a growing one-shot attacker.
**Hold the crown** : Court of Grace, Palace Jailer, Regal Behemoth and Throne of the High City keep re-assigning or defending the monarchy for value.
**Win big** : Doublers like Doubling Season and Branching Evolution explode that counter, and Akroma's Will turns a single attack into a game-ending swing.
primer.combos_note: Okoye has no infinite or looped combos listed on Commander Spellbook — she is a value-and-combat commander, not a combo engine. Games are won by holding the monarch for the extra draw, pumping a designated creature into a double-striking, trampling one-shot attacker, and finishing with Akroma's Will or a doubled Angel swarm rather than through any errant loop.
primer.source_html:
• EDHREC : Okoye's page tags Monarch as her signature game plan, with roughly 194 decks built around holding the crown, with Court of Grace and Palace Jailer among her most-played companions.
  • Scryfall oracle : Every card is grounded in current oracle text; Okoye becomes the monarch on entry and pumps a designated attacker with +1/+1, double strike and trample each combat.
  • Low-data note : Okoye, Mighty and Adored is a relatively new, low-data commander, so the Monarch plan is inferred from her own monarchy ability and the synergy scores of the included cards rather than from a deep deck sample.
  • No combos : Commander Spellbook lists no combos for Okoye, so the deck is built to win through monarch card advantage and a buffed, double-striking attacker rather than loops.
